ancestry_rule: Exact origins are canonical first-parent changes through the authoritative implementation. Published cherry-pick equivalents are identified by package branch/head, not counted as extra changes.

dependency_semantics: prerequisites define conservative package assembly order, not proof each is a C++ textual dependency. Full-client composition prerequisites are separately listed for Miles game selection. Historical test dependency closures do not imply extra source changes must be imported into standalone packages.

next_branch_recipes.note: Next substantial source package. Keep breakpoint prerequisites and the complete owner/stack/hook ABI patch together; existing PR29 is the base.
Next allocator layer. Original order preserves checked sizes, full-width statistics and every consumer, free-node capacity, diagnostics, then realloc metadata/call sites.
One branch composing FPU policy plus the three existing SSE kernel commits. Keep four commits reviewable and retain existing numerical evidence boundaries.

shared_file_split_rules.rule: Use PR29 as base, then owner/stack commit d905, then size/statistics sequence. Do not export final whole files for PR29 or owner-only review. No new allocator design; preserve existing commit hunks.

Native SDK-width/diagnostic repairs precede admitted-worker/facade compile hooks, then game selection/template lifetime. A master-based native-contract package needs only d0fea/25f7/681 hunks, not final Audio.cpp. Last diagnostic commit has later-context ancestry; reconcile context if needed without copying facade logic.
Already submitted shell change and remaining thread-name exception change are separate. Apply eb73 only for thread naming; final whole-file copy would duplicate PR28.
Start storage/decoder package above PR23 and apply residual original commits. Final files on master would resubmit existing wire-contract work.

Generated configuration, original link cleanup, unused-browser removal, provider imports and strict-link/stack policy are distinct chronological hunks. Standalone component branches must extract those hunks or stack exact prerequisites; never copy final central files wholesale.

Keep complete 33efad Release support last, after Audio and Bink selection. Moving Release Audio support earlier requires an explicit manual split of audio/common build and graphics-dependent property hunks. Recommended order avoids that split.

Miles coordinator, wire codec, registry, backend and host are reused by Bink. Apply complete tested Bink extension commits after Miles session/game phases; do not split declarations, dispatch and validation across incompatible revisions.

remaining_claim_limits: No product tests, builds, runtime, cherry-pick attempts, or public writes performed for this map. Git/hash/path accounting is inspection only.
Submitted/prepared status comes from current local status/receipts and observed local refs; no live remote PR merge-state assertion.
Recorded integration validation belongs to named historical inputs. A proposed package branch inherits no exact-head build claim merely through this map.
Private vendor SDK bodies/binaries/media remain out of public packages. Runtime tools/miles-bridge/src is included in production counts.
Full paired-client evidence is a baseline for packaging, not permission to reopen broad gameplay/allocator/media acceptance.
